changes: Stamp worker import build placeholder with upstream commit.
Use one WASM thread when cross-origin isolation is unavailable.
Warm detector and embedder with empty tensors before reporting readiness; no camera frame is used.
Clear camera pixel buffers on request while retaining loaded models and reference data.
Benchmark CPU and WebGPU on a procedural image and the bundled card sample; reject inaccurate or slower GPU inference and fall back after driver failures.
Use up to two CPU threads on Android and four on desktop when cross-origin isolated; retain the single-thread iOS path.
Check a second orientation only for uncertain matches, remembering the last confidently matched orientation.
Optimize perspective sampling and exact packed-f16 catalog search without dropping any catalog rows; release inference tensors after each run.
Expose backend choice, benchmark results and per-frame processing timings.
Support a detector-only worker with one CPU thread and no embedder/catalog, so corner previews can run independently of identification.
Reuse precomputed corners with their exact captured frame and normalize RGB bytes through an exact float32 lookup table.
Send normalized Milo1 embeddings to Deckhand for lookup; keep models on the device and remove cached browser catalogs.
